READ THE REPRESENTATIVE PUBLICATION

Five duties that make equality practical

Born Free and Equal · OHCHR · Foreword by Navi Pillay

This is an OHCHR policy publication—not a personal book by Pillay. Her foreword frames a practical guide to applying existing international human-rights law to violence and discrimination against LGBT people.

01

Protect life and dignity

States must prevent and investigate homophobic and transphobic violence, torture and degrading treatment.

02

Equality is not a special right

Decriminalisation and non-discrimination apply universal protections already guaranteed to every person.

03

Turn law into action

Examples and recommendations connect legal duties to policing, courts, public policy, expression and association.
